concept.title: Green Zone Drive Mode
concept.shortdesc: To protect the atmospheric environment in urban areas, EV mode automatically expands when the vehicle enters a road inside the Green Zone based on navigation information, and also when departing from home based on the driving history.

section.title: Green Zone Drive Mode settings
section.p: When the vehicle is in ON position, tap SettingsVehicleECO VehicleGreen Zone EV Drive from the infotainment system screen.

section.title: Green Zone Drive Mode display
section.p: Green Zone Drive Mode is enabled when the vehicle enters the green zone based on the navigation information in ECO mode.

section.title: Green Zone registration point
section.p: Green Zone registration points are determined based on navigation information and driving history, and may include:

note.p: Even in the Green Zone, EV mode driving may be limited or the engine may start in the following situations:

li.p: When the high voltage battery charge is low.
When engine power is required (such as during acceleration, climbing, heating, or cooling) or when engine operation is necessary for the driving system.
When the Green Zone cannot be recognized due to navigation problems.
The available Green Zone may change through regular navigation updates.
The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.
